note: Rustic state forest campground on the East Branch of the Fox River (a designated natural river known for wild brook trout) and King's Pond, eight miles north of Seney National Wildlife Refuge via M-77 North, Schoolcraft County. A working fish hatchery 1936-1980; concrete release slabs and storage areas remain. The one-mile Steeb Pathway circles King's Pond. ORV and snowmobile riding allowed between the campground and nearby trails (Danaher Plains trailhead 4.5 miles south). --Claude
